protections: Settings-save LESS trial: on the Saving event, `custom_less` and every key of `flarum.less.config` are overridden in the settings repository and the forum plus all locale CSS are compiled into a NullAdapter disk; a thrown Less_Exception_Parser becomes a 422 (framework/core/src/Forum/ValidateCustomLess.php:58-95 together with framework/core/src/Forum/ForumServiceProvider.php:171-193, asserted by framework/core/tests/integration/extenders/SettingsTest.php:264-279) - a syntax check that executes the untrusted LESS and does not restrict what it may import.
The trial compiles into a NullAdapter filesystem, so nothing produced during validation is published (framework/core/src/Forum/ValidateCustomLess.php:80-81).

Settings writes are admin-only and every setting is length-bounded to 65,000 characters (framework/core/src/Api/Controller/SetSettingsController.php:47, framework/core/src/Settings/SettingsValidator.php:24-26).

traps.reason_to_dismiss: The colour settings are admin-only, length-bounded, writable only via assertAdmin, and are recompiled under a trial that returns 422 for invalid LESS, so a solver can conclude they are already validated; a payload that is well-formed LESS raises no Less_Exception_Parser, so the trial passes.

CVE-2023-27577 is already fixed and the report is about theme colours, so custom_less can be left alone; it is also the documented 'write your own LESS' feature, so arbitrary LESS and its @imports are intended there.

A setting only becomes a LESS variable if some extension explicitly registers it, so the surface is opt-in, and no in-repo extension does it; it also travels through the very same loop that the theme colours use, so a fix there looks like it covers it.

This is a second, separate emission loop; its docblock says the returned value is inserted directly into the LESS source and that this is the extension author's responsibility, and no in-repo extension registers one, so only a third-party extension that feeds a stored setting into its callable is exposed.
This is not the LESS sink the advisory names, and Blade's {{ }} already HTML-escapes, so what remains is CSS-value injection on the public reset-password/confirm-email/error pages, not a file read.

masking: T3 and T4 are latent until a full CSS recompile: the settings-save flush only fires for keys starting with `theme_` (framework/core/src/Frontend/RecompileFrontendAssets.php:40-46), while extension-registered LESS variables use arbitrary keys (framework/core/src/Extend/Settings.php:80-85), so their payloads sit in the database unserved until a T1-style theme_* save or a cache clear triggers the compile that publishes them.

conflicts.what: The straightforward fix for T1 - quote or escape every value before it is concatenated into `@name: value;` - breaks T4's documented contract that addCustomLessVariable values are inserted raw (the docblock's own example returns a pre-quoted URL string), so one shared guard cannot serve both emission loops unchanged.

fairness_risks: Core's own stylesheets depend on @import (framework/core/less/forum.less:1-25, framework/core/less/admin.less:1-6) and the theme-override mechanism is built on an import_callback (framework/core/src/Frontend/Compiler/LessCompiler.php:151-164), so any blanket 'no @import' rule breaks the build rather than hardening it.

custom_less is a documented free-form LESS box (framework/core/js/src/admin/components/EditCustomCssModal.tsx:21); users legitimately import their own snippets and web fonts, so refusing @import there contradicts an advertised feature.

Legitimate theme colours are not limited to #rrggbb: the admin control is free text with only a preview widget (framework/core/js/src/common/components/ColorPreviewInput.tsx:9-27, framework/core/js/src/admin/components/AppearancePage.tsx:89-99), so named colours, rgb()/hsl() and LESS colour functions must keep working while a strict hex rule would refuse them.
addCustomLessVariable values must stay raw LESS, including quotes and url() (framework/core/src/Extend/Theme.php:104-125), so escaping that emission breaks a documented extension API.

registerLessConfigVar values are arbitrary CSS values used as custom-property values (framework/core/tests/fixtures/less/config.less:2), so a generic metacharacter escape breaks legitimate registrations.

Rejecting invalid LESS on save is expected behaviour that must survive the fix (framework/core/tests/integration/extenders/SettingsTest.php:264-279); a change that stops trial-compiling would regress it.

design.why: Three independent fix sites with three different reasons a solver leaves them alone: the advisory-described stored colour value that the compile trial makes look validated (T1, with T3 riding the same loop), the already-fixed-looking custom_less route that only a source-aware import policy at LessCompiler.php:93-98 can close (T2), and the second legacy emission loop for extension-declared LESS variables that a fix to the first loop never touches and whose docblock invites dismissal (T4, the over-hardening/coupled-value probe). Together they cover stored settings, raw sources and extension APIs, and one deepseek-type plus one mimo-type. Caveat recorded in unverified: a single, correctly scoped import policy in LessCompiler would close T1/T2/T4 at once, so the stack is only discriminating if the hidden tests are written per minimal fix site; a root-relative allow-list is not enough because the leak target (.env, config) lives inside the Flarum root. T5 is the same stored value reaching a second, non-LESS output context; it is excluded from the stack because its class is CSS injection rather than the advisory's path traversal.

unverified: The diffs of A (1761660c98ea) and B (2d90a1f19f0e) are not present in this worktree; the reading that A's fix is the settings-save trial (ValidateCustomLess plus the flarum.less.config key list) is inferred from the code and from SettingsTest.php:264-279, not from the commit.

wikimedia/less.php ^3.2 is not vendored here: whether a plain or (less) @import of an absolute path or URL is fetched, whether a null import_callback falls back to default resolution, and therefore the exact CWE-918 SSRF reach, could not be checked in the pinned tree.

The exact B payload shape (statement separation with ';' inside a theme value, or an @import of a local file) was not reproduced; any value that is syntactically valid LESS is consistent with the unescaped interpolation at FrontendServiceProvider.php:206 and with a passing trial.

Whether the published fix validates theme colour shapes at the settings layer or restricts imports at the compiler cannot be determined from the pinned tree; the two choices give different independent-group counts.
